title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC High
summary: Hold: the briefing recommends web app and exclusion-list policies for GCC High, but Microsoft's feature access management documentation explicitly excludes that cloud. The roadmap facts and the printed control paths and command are supported; the cloud restriction must be stated before administrators rely on those controls.

claims.quote: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High)

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center path Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add enables access for individual users.
claims.quote: Settings ... Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights ... Set up and management ... Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... select Users ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the web app tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : Viva Insights web app ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: For tenants without a Viva Insights licence, minimum group size is set in Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Viva > Microsoft Viva Insights > Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365 > Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote: If your tenant does not have a Viva Insights license ... go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. ... Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.quote: If you previously removed access to the Copilot Dashboard using Copilot Dashboard feature access management control or PowerShell, those configurations now apply to the entire Viva Insights web app.
